title: The Share of Value a Fare Brand's Credit Term Places on a First Voucher
content:
The credit validity term scheduled for an Air Ticket Fare Brands brand decides what share of the figure reaches the voucher, but only where the booking carries no voucher already.

## 1. The share placed on the voucher

1.1 Where the brand's credit runs 24 months or more and no voucher already stands on the booking, the whole of the figure is placed on the voucher: a share of 1.

1.2 Where the brand's credit runs 12 months or more but fewer than 24 and no voucher already stands on the booking, the mid-credit share is placed on the voucher: 0.95 of it, being 95 percent.

1.3 In every other case no such treatment applies to the share.

## 2. The two tests

The first test reads the credit validity term scheduled for the brand the booking is held in: 24 months or more for the first row, and for the second a term that is 12 months or more and at the same time fewer than 24. The second test counts the credit-issue lines already standing on the booking; "no voucher already stands" means there is none.

A booking that already carries a voucher falls outside both rows whatever the brand's term, and so does a booking held in a brand whose credit runs fewer than 12 months.

## 3. Truth table

| Brand's credit term | A voucher already stands on the booking | Share placed on the voucher |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 24 months or more | no | 1 |
| 24 months or more | yes | no such treatment |
| 12 months or more but fewer than 24 | no | 0.95 |
| 12 months or more but fewer than 24 | yes | no such treatment |
| fewer than 12 months | either | no such treatment |

## 4. Hypothetical readings

A booking held in a brand whose credit runs 24 months, with no credit-issue line standing on it, places the whole of the figure on the voucher. The same booking once a voucher already stands on it falls to the last row.

A booking held in a brand whose credit runs 18 months, with no voucher standing on it, is 12 months or more and fewer than 24, so 95 percent of the figure is placed on the voucher.
